295:t_016:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「W-wait! You can't just spring that on me...!」

295:t_016:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then trust me. I have no intention of lying.」

295:t_016:8.en:
$$シャア$$
「Defeating $$尸空#pilot$$ comes first. But all units, remain on guard.」

295:t_016:11.en:
$$アサキム$$
「In the end, you're just like me. People branded with a $$烙印$$...」

295:t_016:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't have time for your poetry! We've got a guy even gloomier than you to deal with!」

295:t_016:13.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$アサキム$$... I'll put our showdown on hold for now.」

295:t_016:15.en:
$$万丈$$
「Here I come, $$サイデリアル$$! I swear I'll win here on $$火星$$!」

295:t_017:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You may see it that way.」

295:t_017:4.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Even I know better than to fight seven $$スフィア$$s at once.」

295:t_018:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「This is as far as I go.」

295:t_018:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You may see it that way.」

295:t_018:4.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Even I know better than to fight seven $$スフィア$$s at once.」

295:t_020:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Don't pursue him, $$アサキム$$. We needn't rush to settle this here.」

295:t_021:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I have no more business here.」

295:t_021:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Did being sealed inside $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ piss you off that much?!」

295:t_021:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...Not really. I thought sleeping forever like that would be best for both me and you.」

295:t_021:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But now that I've been awakened, I'll struggle. Hideously, shamelessly... and pathetically.」

295:t_022:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「...He does tend to be rather single-minded.」

295:t_022:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$... Were you the one who freed $$アサキム$$ from $$ＺＯＮＥ$$?」

295:t_022:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「No. But circumstances brought us together, and we began traveling together.」

295:t_022:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Have you recruited $$アサキム$$ into the $$クロノ$$ Reformists?」

295:t_022:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You may think of it that way.」

295:t_022:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Before that, why are you alive?」

295:t_022:6.en:
$$オズマ$$
「You were supposed to have died fighting $$ガドライト#pilot$$...」

295:t_022:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Are you unhappy that I'm alive?」

295:t_022:8.en:
$$赤木$$
「That's not what I mean, but...」

295:t_022:9.en:
$$甲児$$
「We've been burned before by someone who played dead.」

295:t_022:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You mean $$偽りの黒羊$$, $$アイム・ライアード$$... Indeed, my survival was due to something similar to his $$スフィア$$'s power.」

295:t_022:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「No, Miss $$スズネ$$. I always speak only the truth.」

295:t_022:13.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$n... You understand that too, don't you?」

295:t_022:15.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I apologize for not telling you I survived. ...But you do trust me, don't you?」

295:t_022:17.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Look into my eyes, $n.」

295:t_023:0.en:
$$ブルー$$
「...I'm sorry, Captain. I've lost sight of $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$.」

295:t_023:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It's all right, $$ブルー$$. He and I are headed to the same destination. He'll return to us eventually.」

295:t_023:3.en:
$$ブルー$$
「It's been a while, $$メール$$. And $$ランド$$ and $$セツコ$$, too.」

295:t_023:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Did you know $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was alive?」

295:t_023:5.en:
$$ブルー$$
「I apologize. We didn't know that ourselves yet when we made contact with you.」

295:t_023:6.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「You appeared in $$第２新東京市$$ when we were about to be caught in $$アマルガム$$'s $$時空震動弾$$...」

295:t_023:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That was on my orders. I tried to suppress the $$時空震動$$, but you know how that turned out.」

295:t_023:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'm sorry about that.」

295:t_023:9.en:
$$ランド$$
「Wait, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Are you leaving?!」

295:t_023:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'm sorry. There are still things I must do.」

295:t_023:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But someday, I'll fight alongside you. After all, we're headed to the same destination.」

295:t_023:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「We'll meet again, $n. I await the day you go beyond hope and despair.」

295:t_024:1.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Everything about him is a mystery.」

295:t_024:2.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Even if you tell me to trust a man like that...」

295:t_024:3.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Leave it, my friend. Think of how $n feels.」

295:t_024:5.en:
$n
「No, it's all right... I haven't quite come to terms with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ being alive myself...」

295:t_024:6.en:
$n
「Of course, I'm glad he's alive, but...」

295:t_024:8.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain...! There's a ship approaching us!」

295:t_025:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I came here on $$ブルー$$'s directions, and man, was this a surprise...」

295:t_025:2.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「What are you doing here?!」

295:t_026:0.en:
$$葵$$
「The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$...!」
